scientific_integrity: An analytic, exact-arithmetic theorem about a fixed two-scalar one-node estimator; independent validation has not been performed. Finite checks supplement but do not certify the general proof.
scientific_limitations: Real symmetric positive-definite 2x2 matrices, Haar-uniform unit-vector marginals, two separately evaluated scalar one-node Lanczos logarithms; no claim for block Lanczos, multiple iterations, other marginals, higher dimensions, or floating-point errors.
title: Sharp antithetic risk law for two one-node Lanczos log-determinant probes
